items.question: What if I forget my BCA Credit Card PIN?
items.answer: You can reactivate your BCA Credit Card PIN through myBCA, BCA mobile, a BCA ATM, or bca.co.id/creditcard under e-Statement & PIN Activation.

items.question: What should I do if my BCA Credit Card is lost or stolen?
items.answer: Block the card immediately through myBCA, BCA mobile, or Halo BCA at 1500888. A card blocked due to loss or theft needs to be replaced before it can be used again.

items.question: How do I pay my BCA Credit Card bill?
items.answer: In myBCA, choose Pay & Top Up, then Credit Card & Paylater. Select the card and funding source, enter the payment amount, review the details, then confirm with your PIN.
